description: This file contains the implementation of a generic Data Access Object (DAO) for OpenMRS objects, providing CRUD operations using Hibernate. It serves as a base class for specific DAO implementations within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: HibernateOpenmrsObjectDAO
classes.description: A generic DAO implementation for OpenMRS objects using Hibernate, supporting basic CRUD operations.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Setter for injecting the Hibernate SessionFactory.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve an object by its ID using Hibernate session.

methods.name: getByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an object by its UUID using a utility method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a persistent object from the database.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save or update the provided object in the database.
